lines.text: After three quiet years, Jehoshaphat visits Ahab, who asks him to fight Aram for Ramoth-gilead, and he agrees.
Jehoshaphat asks Ahab to inquire of the LORD first, so Ahab assembles about four hundred prophets, who say go up.
Zedekiah makes iron horns to gore the Philistines, and all the prophets promise victory at Ramoth-gilead.
Micaiah says he saw the LORD on His throne, and a lying spirit was put in the mouths of Ahab's prophets.
Ahab orders Micaiah returned to Amon and Joash, to be fed bread and water at the gate until he returns safely.
